issues.jp_before: 誰[だれ]{とて/といえども|tote}、失敗[しっぱい]{は|wa-contrast}したくない。
issues.problem: 誰といえども is not idiomatic (the set phrase is 何人といえども); it should not be listed as an accepted answer.
issues.action: Removed といえども from the slot alternatives.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{が/の|ga-subject}降[ふ]った{とて/としたところで|tote}、試合[しあい]{は|wa-topic}中止[ちゅうし]{に|ni-change}なりません。
issues.problem: The ga/no conversion only works in noun-modifying clauses, not before とて, so の is not a valid alternative.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}、自分[じぶん]{が|ga-subject}負[ま]ける{など|nado-etc}想像[そうぞう]{だに/すら/さえ|dani}していなかった。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate: 想像だに appeared in five items, and this one repeated the 'did not even imagine that ...' frame of another item.
issues.action: Replaced with a new dani item using the set phrase 身じろぎだにせず.

issues.jp_before: 最初[さいしょ]{から|kara-from}、成功[せいこう]{など|nado-etc}期待[きたい]{だに/すら/さえ|dani}できなかった。
issues.problem: 期待だにできない is a marginal collocation; the natural form is 期待だにしない.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 期待だにしていなかった and adjusted the English and the why.

issues.jp_before: 家族[かぞく]{の|no-possessive}悲[かな]しみ{を|o-object}思[おも]う{だに|dani}、言葉[ことば]{が|ga-existence}ない。
issues.problem: Awkward Japanese (思うだに、言葉がない) and an unnatural English translation.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 遺族の気持ちを思うだに、涙が出る with new English.

issues.jp_before: 祖父[そふ]{は|wa-topic}今[いま]{も|mo-also}昔[むかし]{ながらに|nagarani}、毎朝[まいあさ]五時[ごじ]{に|ni-time}起[お]き{て|te-sequence}庭[にわ]{を|o-object}掃[は]く。
issues.problem: 今も here means 'still' and is not mo-also, and no catalog skill fits it.
issues.action: Removed 今も, set f from 2 to 1 and adjusted the English.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}涙[なみだ]{ながらに|nagarani}感謝[かんしゃ]{の|no-possessive}言葉[ことば]{を|o-object}口[くち]{に|ni-change}した。
issues.problem: Ten of the twenty items used 涙ながらに (poor variety), and 口にする is not a ni-change use.
issues.action: Replaced with a 子供ながらに item, listing ながら and ながらも as alternatives.

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}涙[なみだ]{ながらに|nagarani}許[ゆる]し{を|o-object}乞[こ]うた。
issues.action: Replaced with a 幼いながらに item, listing ながら and ながらも as alternatives.

issues.jp_before: 買[か]い物[もの]{がてら|gatera}、友達[ともだち]{の|no-possessive}家[いえ]{に|ni-destination}寄[よ]った。
issues.problem: The verb 寄る was used in five items (the limit is three).
issues.action: Changed the verb to 顔を出した.

issues.jp_before: 運動[うんどう]{がてら|gatera}、駅[えき]{まで|made-until}一駅分[ひとえきぶん]歩[ある]く。
issues.problem: 駅まで一駅分歩く is redundant and unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 隣の駅まで歩いた with new English.

issues.jp_before: ご報告[ほうこく]{がてら/かたがた|gatera}、近況[きんきょう]{を|o-object}お知[し]らせします。
issues.problem: Semantically odd (the report and the news of how I've been are the same thing), and in a formal letter かたがた, not がてら, would be the best answer.
issues.action: Replaced with a 花見がてら item.

issues.jp_before: 旅行[りょこう]{がてら|gatera}、地元[じもと]{の|no-possessive}友達[ともだち]{に|ni-target}会[あ]ってきた。
issues.problem: Meeting a friend from my hometown while travelling is incoherent.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 大阪旅行がてら、向こうに住む友達に会ってきた with new English.
